name: legate
description: Delegated work orchestration for agent sessions. Dispatch work to native Codex or Claude backends with tmux as a compatibility fallback, then debrief, watch, show logs, stop, or attach when supported.

interface.shortDescription: Dispatch and manage delegated agent work
interface.longDescription: Dispatch work to native Codex or Claude backends with tmux as a compatibility fallback. Debrief progress, watch for meaningful changes, show logs where available, stop delegated work, and attach only when the backend supports it.
defaultPrompt: Dispatch delegated agent work for this task.
Show logs for the active delegated handle.
